name: Toolbar
description: Keyboard-navigable composition of slotted action controls.

accessibility.navigation: ArrowLeft/Right in horizontal, ArrowUp/Down in vertical, Home/End; skip disabled
accessibility.composition: Supports buttons, cu-button, cu-icon-button, cu-split-button, cu-select, cu-toggle-button-group and explicit data-toolbar-control
accessibility.notes: Children own events; Toolbar does not intercept activation
